extracted.name: Quesadilla Sauce
extracted.description: This homemade quesadilla sauce made with mayo, spices, and jalapeños adds a creamy, tangy, and deliciously spicy flavor to your favorite quesadilla.
ingredient_lines: 3 tablespoons canned diced jalapeno peppers, drained (reserve juice)
instruction_lines: Mix mayonnaise, jalapeño peppers, 3 tablespoons of pickling juice from peppers, sugar, paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, and salt together in a bowl.
